class.name: OcgIntpolyhMaillageaffinage
class.brief_description: Low-level algorithm to compute intersection of the surfaces by computing the intersection of their triangulations.
class.description: ! Low-level algorithm to compute intersection of the surfaces ! by computing the intersection of their triangulations.

method.name: MakeSampling
method.description: Makes the sampling of the surface - Fills the arrays with the parametric values of the sampling points (triangulation nodes).

method.name: FillArrayOfPnt_1
method.description: Computes points on one surface and fills an array of points; standard (default) method

method.name: FillArrayOfPnt_2
method.description: isShiftFwd flag is added. The purpose is to define shift of points along normal to the surface in this point. The shift length represents maximal deflection of triangulation. The direction (forward or reversed regarding to normal direction) is defined by isShiftFwd flag. Compute points on one surface and fill an array of points; advanced method

method.name: CommonBox_1
method.description: Looks for the common box of the surfaces and marks the points of the surfaces inside that common box for possible intersection

method.name: CommonBox_2
method.description: Compute the common box witch is the intersection of the two bounding boxes, and mark the points of the two surfaces that are inside.

method.name: FillArrayOfEdges
method.description: Compute edges from the array of points

method.name: FillArrayOfTriangles
method.description: Compute triangles from the array of points, and -- mark the triangles that use marked points by the CommonBox function.

method.name: CommonPartRefinement
method.description: Refine systematicaly all marked triangles of both surfaces

method.name: LocalSurfaceRefinement
method.description: Refine systematicaly all marked triangles of ONE surface

method.name: ComputeDeflections
method.description: Compute deflection for all triangles of one surface,and sort min and max of deflections

method.name: TrianglesDeflectionsRefinementBSB
method.description: Refine both surfaces using BoundSortBox as -- rejection. The criterions used to refine a -- triangle are: The deflection The size of the -- bounding boxes (one surface may be very small compared to the other)

method.name: TriContact
method.description: This function checks if two triangles are in contact or not, return 1 if yes, return 0 if not.

method.name: StartingPointsResearch
method.description: From two triangles compute intersection points. If we found more than two intersection points that means that those triangles are coplanar

method.name: NextStartingPointsResearch
method.description: from two triangles and an intersection point I search the other point (if it exists). This function is used by StartPointChain

method.name: TriangleCompare
method.description: Analyse each couple of triangles from the two -- array of triangles, to see if they are in contact, and compute the incidence. Then put couples in contact in the array of couples

method.name: GetCouples
method.description: This method returns list of couples of contact triangles.
